MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made between Alpha LLC ("Provider") and Beta Inc. ("Client") effective January 1, 2026.

Payment Terms
Client shall pay Provider USD 25,000 within thirty (30) days of invoice.

Termination
Either party may terminate for material breach with 30 days cure period.

Limitation of Liability
Neither party shall be liable for indirect damages. Total liability is capped at fees paid in prior 12 months.

Confidentiality
Both parties will maintain confidentiality of proprietary information.

Dispute Resolution
Disputes will be resolved by arbitration in New York.

Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of New York.
